claims: As of late March 2026, average U.S. mortgage rates for 30-year fixed loans have daily volatility.
As of late March 2026, U.S. mortgage rates recently rose to their highest level in over three months.
U.S. mortgage rates dipped below 6% earlier in 2026.
Many advertised rates such as 6.62% include discount points.
In March 2026, 30-Year Fixed mortgage rates are 6.38% - 6.62%.
In March 2026, 15-Year Fixed mortgage rates are 5.50% - 5.85%.
In March 2026, FHA 30-Year Fixed mortgage rates are 5.725% - 6.12%.
In March 2026, VA 30-Year Fixed mortgage rates are 5.675% - 6.07%.
In March 2026, Jumbo 30-Year mortgage rates are 6.00% - 6.65%.
